subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps (NimbusWorks)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@nimbusworks.com>, Susan Owens <susan.owens@nimbusworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 14:02:00 -0000
Subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps (NimbusWorks)

Tom / Susan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned with your exec/procurement timelines. I tried to keep this short for your execs.

Key pain points discussed:
- High latency on your embeddings-based search pipeline causing slow relevance updates during peak windows.
- Cost unpredictability with current serving approach; you mentioned concerns about per-query spend on spikes.
- Audit/compliance: SOC 2 scope and data residency are blockers for procurement right now.

Goals & success metrics we heard:
- Production inference p95 <40ms for 512-token search queries.
- Reduce per-query serving cost by ~25% within 6 months of rollout.
- Security & legal sign-off (SOC2 evidence and architecture review) completed by end of Q2 to keep the product launch timeline.

Business outcomes / risks:
- Hitting latency/cost targets directly impacts retention and conversion for paid tiers — measurable MRR impact.
- Procurement/legal timeline is the primary gating risk; long legal cycles would delay the launch.

Procurement path / asks:
1) Please confirm executive sponsor (you mentioned Tom) and primary procurement/legal contact (Susan).
2) We'll share SOC2 summary, security deck, and a 1-page exec brief today.
3) Proposed next meeting: 30-min exec alignment the week of Apr 12 to confirm success metrics and procurement milestones.
4) Pilot plan: propose a 6-week canary pilot with defined KPIs; Redwood will scope infra and provide a pilot pricing offset.

Attachments: redwood-enterprise-trial-overview.pdf; pilot-scope-nimbusworks.xlsx

Next steps:
- Tom / Susan: confirm sponsor & procurement contact
- Susan: confirm legal / procurement availability for an initial security review
- Laura: will send SOC2 + exec one-pager + HubSpot link (below)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
(555) 555-0198
From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@nimbusworks.com>

Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap & next steps (NimbusWorks)

Laura —

Appreciate the clear summary. Confirming a few items from our side:
- Executive sponsor: yes, I will act as exec sponsor.
- Procurement / legal contact: Susan Owens (cc'd) is our procurement lead and will drive legal review.
- Timeline: our budget window closes at the end of Q2; we need security and procurement sign-off by then to keep the launch on track.

Requests from us: 
1) Please send SOC 2 report (or summary) and the security/architecture deck.
2) One-page executive brief focused on business outcomes & runway to ROI — this helps with the C-suite ask.
3) If you can outline the pilot KPIs and the exact pricing offset for the 6-week canary, that would be helpful for our procurement conversation.

We are generally positive about a canary pilot — low risk to run and will surface the metrics we care about. Susan / legal: I think a short technical security review is the immediate next step. Susan, can you confirm your availability next week for a 30-min sync?

Thanks,
Tom
VP Product
NimbusWorks
tom.harris@nimbusworks.com
